product_overview: Muster is a local-first desktop app (Electron + React/Vite) for running a personal team of AI agents. Each agent ('bot') is a real model/CLI engine with its own chat thread, personality and computer. Users talk to bots like contacts, watch them work, and approve what matters. A local server (Node, port 8799) serves both the API and the built UI.
core_goals: Give every agent its own persistent chat thread that renders messages reliably
Let users create agents from the sidebar and navigate between threads safely
Keep the local-first privacy posture: no forced accounts, data on disk
Make shared team context available read-only to all agents
Stay stable: no console errors or crashes during everyday flows

features.name: App Shell & Boot
features.description: The app loads at / with a sidebar of bots/groups plus chat area; empty states render when no bots exist; health endpoint answers.
user_flows: Open the app and see the team sidebar
Empty state guidance when roster is empty

features.name: Bot Management
features.description: Users create new bots via the sidebar add-agent control; each bot appears in the list with its own thread.
user_flows: Create a bot named E2E Bot
See it appear in the sidebar

features.name: Chat Messaging
features.description: Each bot has a transcript + composer. Sent user messages must render immediately as bubbles in order; whitespace-only sends are ignored; windowing keeps long threads performant.
user_flows: Send a message and see it immediately
Send consecutive messages with correct ordering

features.name: Find in Conversation
features.description: Cmd/Ctrl+F inside an open bot chat or room opens a debounced search bar over the thread using /api/search.
user_flows: Press Cmd/Ctrl+F to open the find bar

features.name: Rooms (Group Chat)
features.description: Multi-agent rooms with members, bulletin pin and per-room transcripts separate from DMs.
user_flows: Open a room and see members header

features.name: Settings
features.description: Settings modal with General/Appearance/Connections/Engines/MCP sections. General includes Profile fields and the Team Context brief textarea (saved to /api/team-context).
user_flows: Edit team context brief and save

features.name: Navigation Integrity
features.description: Switching between bots keeps transcripts isolated; returning restores prior messages.
user_flows: Marker message in bot A invisible in bot B
Marker persists when returning to bot A

code_summary: Single-package TypeScript app: src/ = React 19 + Vite UI (ChatView, GroupView, SettingsModal, ChatFindBar), server/ = Node HTTP API (index.ts routes incl. /api/search, /api/team-context, /api/config), electron/ shell. Tests: vitest unit + Playwright e2e. No auth gate locally; engine CLIs may be absent so bot replies are not required — assert only sent-user-message rendering.
